draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The package contains only exp1 (original labels, T1). No noise-perturbation experiments, no T2 table, and no F1-drop values (0.6/1.3/1.8) are present. The cited evidence IDs (T2.r1.th_drop etc.) do not exist in the package. The claim is entirely unsupported.
